title: Studies
subtitle: Measure what changed: ask the same questions before and after a training, a new service or a campaign, and see the difference in one report.
readOnly: You can view studies. Managers and owners can create and edit them.

empty.title: Run your first before-and-after study
empty.body: A study pairs two surveys with the same questions. Participants answer once before and once after, and Satis shows what changed.

steps.during: Run your training, service or campaign
steps.after: Share the after-survey and read the report

new.title: New study
new.body: Name the study and choose starting questions. You can edit both surveys afterwards.
new.name: Study name
new.namePlaceholder: For example: Customer service training, March
new.descriptionHint: Optional. What you're measuring and why.

research.title: Before and after
research.body: Knowledge, confidence and how often, rated 1 to 5, plus a comment.

satisfaction.title: Customer satisfaction
satisfaction.body: The post-visit survey: rating, what they liked, recommendation and a comment.

new.matchHint: Participants enter a code (for example P-014) in both surveys, so the report compares each person's before and after. Turn off for anonymous studies.

surveys.title: Surveys
surveys.differ: The after-survey asks different questions from the before-survey. Only matching questions are compared.
surveys.copied: Questions copied. Publish the after-survey to use them.
surveys.codesBody: Give each participant a code, such as P-001, and ask them to use it in both surveys. To fill it in for them, add it to the survey link:

report.title: Results
report.followUpHint: Share of before-participants who also answered after
report.empty: No answers yet. Share the before-survey to start collecting.
report.noAnswers: No answers to this question yet.
report.notSignificant: Could be chance (p of 0.05 or more)
report.notEnough: Needs at least 2 answers before and after to test.

template.name: Study survey
template.knowledge: How would you rate your knowledge of the topic?
template.confidence: How confident do you feel putting it into practice?
template.frequency: How often do you use it today?
template.comment: Is there anything you'd like to add?
template.thankYou: Thank you for taking part. Your answers help us measure what works.
